data.body:
Final CI and landing evidence.

PS2 run 32202582480 failed Ubuntu Python 3.11/3.12 integration with repo-root .pytest_cache leak errors. Root cause: the held-out portability test launched nested pytest without disabling cacheprovider while the outer xdist CI invocation used -p no:cacheprovider; the nested process created .pytest_cache and concurrent leak guards detected it. This was classified as a test-harness environment-integration defect, not retried unchanged.

PS4 dabb270321d5e3fee1b1be781d29f82cc3853901 added -p no:cacheprovider to the nested pytest command. Exact focused RED was reproduced before the fix, GREEN was 1/1 after it, removing the flag re-seeded the identical RED, and the restored fix passed the focused xdist pair 2/2. make lint, make typecheck, and git diff --check passed locally. CI run 32204347338 completed success across the full matrix, including Ubuntu Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS Python 3.13; retry count 0.

Gerrit change 1882 reached LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments, then merged via Rebase-If-Necessary as f2eae0d34c156a9c1467207be62245647f690b1c. GitHub mirror origin/main now points exactly to that merged SHA.
